name: Animal Companion (Trainer Perk)
body:
You gain the animal companion class feature as a druid of your monster trainer level –3. Your animal companion must be an animal you have captured that qualifies to be a druid’s animal companion. When you call upon it as your active monster, the chosen animal functions as an animal companion and still grants you trainer spells.
